verdict.rationale: The evidence shows background, unattended execution in a few forms: RSS campaigns send on their own schedule, Transactional sends event-driven messages, and webhooks push subscription and campaign events to external endpoints (Standard/Premium plans only). Analytics AI refers to 'automations' as a product feature, but no evidence documents how to set up or configure automated journeys or workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of an automation/journey builder (triggers, conditions, multi-step flows), AI-driven or agentic automation setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably on their own.
